name: oracle-firefox
description: Durable, Pro-verified ChatGPT consultation through the user's authenticated Firefox.
longDescription: One per-user broker coordinates Codex, Claude Code, Claudex, and Claude Desktop through one authenticated Firefox. Jobs are durable, same-chat FIFO, exact-turn correlated, fail closed at the submission boundary, and able to request safe local evidence.

tools.name: setup
tools.description: Open the dedicated Firefox login flow.

tools.name: profiles
tools.description: Find Firefox profiles with ChatGPT cookies without exposing values.

tools.name: import_session
tools.description: Import only ChatGPT/OpenAI cookies after explicit approval.

tools.name: consult
tools.description: Start a compatible durable consultation and wait briefly.

tools.name: continue_chat
tools.description: Continue one exact conversation and wait briefly.

tools.name: consult_start
tools.description: Start a durable consultation and return immediately.

tools.name: continue_chat_start
tools.description: Start a durable existing-chat continuation and return immediately.

tools.name: job_wait
tools.description: Long-poll one job for up to 55 seconds.

tools.name: job_result
tools.description: Read a completed answer or terminal outcome.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List recent durable jobs without prompts.

tools.name: reconcile_job
tools.description: Read-only reconciliation for an uncertain submission.

tools.name: acknowledge_uncertain
tools.description: Remove a quarantine after manual inspection.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel before submit-intent or detach afterward.

tools.name: broker_status
tools.description: Inspect broker, browser, and queue health.

tools.name: reply_with_local_data
tools.description: Send one safe structured local-evidence reply.
